purpose: Fix intranet browser crashes/restarts by decoupling Chromium into a dedicated container (4G mem limit, restart on-failure, persistent profile) and replacing the browser-use execution layer with a self-built thin DrissionPage 4.0.5.6 MCP exposing 4 fixed tools plus a hardened action library.

upstream.licenseNote: custom license; personal/non-profit use per delivery owner; commercial use requires authorization from the copyright holder
upstream.docsSnapshot: docs/reference/DrissionPageDocs4.0.5.6 (offline API reference used for implementation)

browserRuntime.source: existing cowagent-offline:2.1.7-base.1-dev image (no new image transferred)
browserRuntime.cdpEndpoint: browser:9222 (container network; host loopback 127.0.0.1:39222 for ops/verify)

offlineRuntime: All Python dependencies (DrissionPage 4.0.5.6 closure) are bundled as wheels unpacked under toolpacks/python/drissionpage/site-packages.
Python 3.11.15 interpreter is reused from the 1.1.0 baseline browser-use toolpack runtime.
The mcp SDK 1.26.0 is copied from the baseline browser-use site-packages; no fastmcp, no uv, no pip install at deployment time.
browser-dp attaches to an existing browser via CDP with existing_only=True; it can never spawn a browser inside the cowagent container.
mcpConfigChanges: mcpServers.browser-use set to disabled:true but kept for rollback.
mcpServers.browser-dp added with fixed 4 tools: browser_run, browser_snapshot, browser_screenshot, browser_exec.
localAdaptations: Thin MCP written from scratch following the tool-set design of upstream DrissionPageMCP (not adopted as-is; it targets DrissionPage 4.1.x API).
Action library with element ref registry, auto-reconnect, tab governance (cleanup_tabs, max 8 tabs), path whitelist for downloads/uploads.
browser_exec escape hatch guarded by static AST checks against os/subprocess/socket and dangerous builtins.
Compose COMPOSE_FILE chain persisted in compose/.env so later patch restarts keep the browser service.
